title: Contrastive Learning for Interpretable Anomaly Detection at Collider Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2608.13652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generic event-level anomaly detection for collider physics has two recurring problems: anomaly scores are hard to interpret, and they correlate strongly with energy scale and object multiplicity. We present Organized Representation via Contrastive learning for Anomaly detection (ORCA), a two-stage framework that first learns an embedding space via supervised contrastive learning across a diverse set of physics processes, then runs a standard autoencoder in that space to generate event-level anomaly scores. On a simulated dataset consistent with conditions at the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider, ORCA delivers significant gains in both breadth and depth of sensitivity to new physics signals with respect to a baseline autoencoder architecture. translated_title: 基于对比学习的可解释异常检测在碰撞实验中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13652v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对撞机物理中的通用事件级异常检测存在两个反复出现的问题：异常分数难以解释，并且它们与能量规模和物体多重性强烈相关。我们提出了“通过对比学习进行异常检测的有组织表示”（ORCA），这是一个两阶段框架，首先通过监督对比学习在多样化的物理过程集合中学习一个嵌入空间，然后在该空间中运行标准自编码器以生成事件级异常分数。在与高亮度大型强子对撞机条件一致的模拟数据集上，ORCA相对于基线自编码器架构，在新物理信号的敏感度广度和深度方面均取得了显著提升。除了提高敏感度外，对比嵌入使异常样本具有可解释性：因为已知过程占据空间的不同区域，最大似然模板拟合可提供清晰的物理理解。
tldr: ORCA通过两阶段对比学习框架，在提高异常检测敏感度的同时，利用嵌入空间的可解释性解决了异常分数难以解释和与能量规模强相关的问题。
en_tdlr: ORCA uses a two-stage contrastive learning framework to enhance anomaly detection sensitivity while leveraging embedding-space interpretability to address score interpretability and energy-scale correlation issues.
